ask: Lanes 2, 3 and 7 of the premises brief; its full text is in the Ask of c7 (fix the reply-style conflict). Plan: plans/premise-handoffs-plan.md in the project files. Your ruling, Oct 21: evidence lives inside its record; add that clause to cull-rules.
note: Your point, Oct 21: handoffs at token thresholds plus auto-compaction already give a long goal a fresh start, so no fresh-session trigger. A compaction and a new session share one gap: both inherit the handoff's premises. Plan, Oct 21 (plans/premise-handoffs-plan.md): the handoff gains Goal and Working premises sections; each premise carries a source kind (ruling, measured, read, notes, assumed); notes and assumed are weak and get re-checked before anyone acts on them; after a compaction the existing reorient hook lists which to re-check; a wrong premise is rewritten or deleted, never logged. Compaction threshold, Oct 21: yours is 500k (chosen arbitrarily). Advisor pick, a judgment and not measured: about 250k for an orchestrator once this step lands, since cheap premise-checked compactions make a lower threshold safe; keep 500k until then. Keeping orchestrators lean (big reads go to subagents) matters more than the number. Rewrite cadence, checked at 73ed71a7: the handoff is rewritten on a Stop nudge at fixed 200k, 350k and 450k tokens, compaction at 500k; the plan leaves this unchanged. Additions, advisor Oct 21, from web practice (Anthropic's long-running harness article, a Claude Code compaction guide, a Codex/OpenCode comparison): (1) nudges as fractions of autoCompactWindow (about 40, 70 and 90%), since fixed numbers stop firing if the window drops to 250k; (2) also update the handoff on events (a ruling, a finished step, a test result that changes what fails), small edits, with the token nudges as backstop; (3) the PreCompact digest keeps every owner message verbatim, not only the last 60,000 characters. Your rulings, Oct 21: 1 and 2 approved, added to the brief as lane 8 (the prompt today asks for rewrites only at the nudges and after compaction, not on events); 4 is covered by the premise re-check; 3 approved too, in the light version (owner messages verbatim, long pastes cut to their first lines, digest file only), added to lane 8. Raw evidence lives inside the decision or debt that uses it (an Evidence section of about 10 lines, deleted with the record), not a measurements/ folder; that needs one clause added to decision cull-rules, your word. Goal session report, Oct 22: evidence clause in batch #562; premise section in the handoff built and reviewed, waiting for the next batch (batch 6). Landed in #566 (batch-oct23a, Oct 23), checked at claude-settings f463787 (main, Oct 25): handoffs carry Goal and Working premises (hooks/precompact_handoff_prompt.md, decision precompact-handoff).
title: Handoffs list premises with sources, and raw evidence gets one home
why: Feedback you brought, Oct 21: lanes reasoned from summaries ('6 to 8 pythons, from notes') instead of the data, and a long-running session carries its own wrong beliefs forward.
